from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
from html.parser import HTMLParser

src_path=Path('/inputs/report.html')
out_path=Path('/work/report.html')
original=src_path.read_bytes()
closing=b'</head>'
assert original.count(closing)==1
insertion=(
    b'<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).">\n'
    b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'
)
pos=original.index(closing)
edited=original[:pos]+insertion+original[pos:]
edited.decode('utf-8')
out_path.write_bytes(edited)

# Re-read and inspect the actual output.
actual=out_path.read_bytes()
assert actual==edited
assert actual[:pos]==original[:pos]
assert actual[pos+len(insertion):]==original[pos:]
assert actual[:pos]+actual[pos+len(insertion):]==original
assert actual.count(closing)==1
assert actual[pos:pos+len(insertion)]==insertion

class MetaInspector(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.metas=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag.lower()=='meta':
            self.metas.append(attrs)

parser=MetaInspector()
parser.feed(actual.decode('utf-8'))
target=[]
for attrs in parser.metas:
    d=dict(attrs)
    if d.get('name') in ('description','robots'):
        target.append((attrs,d))
assert len(target)==2
assert target[0][0]==[('name','description'),('content','AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).')]
assert target[1][0]==[('name','robots'),('content','noindex, nofollow')]
assert len(target[0][0])==2 and len(target[1][0])==2

print('wrote', out_path)
print('input_size', len(original), 'output_size', len(actual), 'inserted_bytes', len(insertion))
print('input_sha256', hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())
print('output_sha256', hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest())
print('verified_original_bytes_unchanged_outside_insertion', True)
print('inserted_output_context', repr(actual[pos-20:pos+len(insertion)+len(closing)].decode('utf-8')))
print('decoded_target_meta', [x[1] for x in target])
